description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007 Order under Section 2 (Special Commodity Levy for Potatoes Rs. 50 per Kg.)
categorisation: This gazette content involves the imposition of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It constitutes a regulatory order that modifies tax/levy rates on specific commodities (potatoes), which falls under legal/regulatory matters. While it mentions Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities in detail (only his title is stated as part of the authorization), and the primary focus is on regulatory implementation rather than government personnel or structure.
